client_stacker.unsupported_version.help: Server confirmations changed in 26.3. Crafting and trading automation are disabled. Balance display and settings remain available.
client_stacker.trade.help: Buy once using your limits and enabled conversions.
client_stacker.protected_slots.help: Marked slots are excluded from automation.
client_stacker.controls.help: %s: unpack. %s: compact at a crafting table. Hold Shift to repeat.
client_stacker.materials.help: Unpack this material when a managed trade needs it.
client_stacker.setting.enabled.help: Allow Client Stacker to craft and trade.
client_stacker.setting.server.help: Allow automation here. Singleplayer uses a separate setting.
client_stacker.setting.emeralds.help: Unpack emerald blocks when a managed purchase needs emeralds.
client_stacker.setting.balance.help: Count plain emeralds and emerald blocks in the trading screen.
client_stacker.setting.auto_compact.help: Compact eligible resources when opening an empty crafting table. Keeps each material's reserve.
client_stacker.setting.netherite.help: Allow netherite block conversions. Disabled by default.
client_stacker.setting.reserve.help: Leave this many loose items when compacting. Applies to each material.
client_stacker.setting.retain.help: Minimum emerald value after a purchase, including blocks. Protected slots do not fund trades.
client_stacker.setting.spending.help: Maximum emeralds spent by one trade request. Zero means no cap.
client_stacker.setting.target.help: Stop before the purchased item would exceed this inventory count. Zero means no target.
client_stacker.setting.timeout.help: Wait 5–15 seconds for the server before stopping.
client_stacker.settings.invalid: Enter whole numbers; timeout must be 5–15 seconds.
client_stacker.message.cursor: Put down the item on your cursor first.
client_stacker.message.grid: Clear the crafting grid or trade inputs first.
client_stacker.message.grid_screen: Open your inventory to unpack, or a crafting table to compact.
client_stacker.message.material: This item has no enabled conversion.
client_stacker.message.components: This trade has custom ingredients and cannot be automated.
client_stacker.message.not_enough_items: Not enough items after keeping your reserve.
client_stacker.message.resources: Not enough enabled, unprotected resources for this trade.
client_stacker.message.ready: The requested quantity is already available.
client_stacker.message.material_reserve: Stopped to keep your material reserve.
client_stacker.message.no_space: Make room for the result and remaining ingredients.
client_stacker.message.merchant: Stopped: the original villager is unavailable or out of reach.
client_stacker.message.interaction_hand: Leave one hand empty to reopen the villager safely.
client_stacker.message.changed: Stopped: the inventory changed. Check its contents before retrying.
client_stacker.message.timeout: Stopped waiting for the server. Check the grid and inventory before retrying.
client_stacker.message.recipe: Stopped: the server returned a different recipe result.
client_stacker.message.uncertain: Trade stopped: the result could not be confirmed. It will not be repeated.
client_stacker.message.offer: Stopped: the original trade changed or is ambiguous.
client_stacker.message.price: Stopped: the trade became more expensive.
client_stacker.message.protected_trade: Move matching protected or custom ingredients out of this inventory before trading.
client_stacker.message.input_provenance: Clear the trade inputs first so protected resources can be checked.
client_stacker.message.cancelled: Cancelled. Completed conversions and purchases are kept.
client_stacker.message.save: Settings could not be saved. Check config/client-stacker.json and the game log.
client_stacker.message.vtp_unknown: This Villager Trading Plus version has no supported handoff. Its controls are unchanged.
client_stacker.message.limit.reserve: Stopped to keep your emerald reserve.
